title: Angular overlap of two halfplanes
statement: For every real $\alpha$ with $0\le\alpha\le\pi$, the Lebesgue measure of the angles $\theta\in(-\pi,\pi)$ satisfying both $\cos\theta\le0$ and $\cos(\theta-\alpha)\le0$ is $\pi-\alpha$.
replaced: For every real $\alpha\in[0,\pi]$, the Lebesgue measure of $\{\theta\in(-\pi,\pi):\cos\theta\le0,\ \cos(\theta-\alpha)\le0\}$ equals $\pi-\alpha$.
